result.finding: No system packages are installed in the container images. The generated Dockerfiles (web and worker) contain no RUN instructions with package manager commands. The base image eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine provides only the Alpine Linux JRE environment. Any packages included come from the base image itself (Alpine Linux minimal packages + Eclipse Temurin JRE).
evidence: No apt-get, apt, apk add, yum install, or dnf install commands in generated Dockerfiles
Generated Dockerfile instructions: FROM, WORKDIR, COPY, EXPOSE, ENTRYPOINT only (no RUN)
scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh generates Dockerfiles without any RUN package installation steps
Base image eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine includes only Alpine minimal packages + Eclipse Temurin JRE
values: Base image packages only: Alpine Linux minimal (busybox, musl libc) + Eclipse Temurin JRE 21
Package manager: apk (Alpine) — not used in Dockerfile
No web servers, SSL certs, database clients, or build tools added
